beat.description: Story beat / visual intent for the frame (the picture core instruction).

perspective.description: first = POV (triggers first-person framing), third = cinematic.

refAssetIds.description: character_ref / scene_ref registry ids used as read-only reference images.

styleAxes.description: Per-node style-axis override (wb-reel 3-axis). Falls back to game-level manifest.styleAxes. artMedia+filmLook compose the uiStylePrompt.

mode.description: keyframe (default) = single colored keyframe -> shot_image. grid_storyboard = 6-panel black-and-white previs storyboard -> grid_storyboard.

grid.description: Extra inputs when mode=grid_storyboard (all optional). originalPrompt/referenceCount/sceneRefReady are derived internally.

panelLabels.description: Render panel numbers + shot notes inside each panel (default true).

nodeRole.description: Node semantic role; ending / key-choice inject extra freeze-frame hard contracts.
